text:
rachel_billing: FYI 12: acquirer flagged a DUPLICATE_CHARGE on invoice INV-100412 for vendor account EdgeScale LLC. They think the customer was charged twice for the same pro plan. Need dispute evidence packet and reconciliation by EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: Alert: DISPUTE_OPEN dispute_id=dp_7mL2 amount=4800.00 currency=USD reason=duplicate_charge open_ts=1963110000

kim_support: I pulled the support thread — customer reached out saying they saw two invoices on Mar 20 and asked for refund; our agent issued a prorated credit on Mar 21 and noted duplicate. Ticket #6012. I can attach the chat transcript and refund note.

tom_fraud: Quick checks: Payment provider shows two auths but only one capture (capture on auth_9aB3). The second auth voided automatically within 24h. We should provide gateway logs showing void, the capture receipt, and bank receipt. Also include our reconciliation csv.

devops_ops: Metering shows only one active subscription for acct es-2231 between Mar 18-22. No double provisioning. Uploading audit logs now: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-100412/provisioning_audit.log

rachel_billing: Adding core txn details here: 

``
Invoice: INV-100412
Customer: EdgeScale LLC (acct es-2231)
Amount: $4,800.00
Charge IDs: ch_Au9k22 (captured), ch_Au9k22-aux (auth_voided)
Payment method: Visa **** 5678
Opened as: duplicate_charge
Gateway note: second auth voided 2026-03-21T03:14:22Z
``

nina_legal: For duplicates we prefer: capture receipts, merchant settlement report, refund/credit memo (if any), support transcript, and internal reconciliation showing single capture. Also include agent notes about customer contact and any proactive credits/refunds.

kim_support: Uploaded ticket transcript + refund memo to disputes bucket. Excerpt: 
> customer: "I see two charges, please refund the duplicate"
> agent: "We see one settled charge and one voided auth; issuing credit for the charged amount to be safe."

billing-bot: Reminder: Evidence window for duplicate_charge disputes is 5 business days from open. Time left: 4 days 23 hours.

tom_fraud: I'll draft a one-paragraph rebuttal summarizing: single capture, second auth voided, no duplicate provisioning, proactive credit issued. Will attach gateway logs and settlement batch.

devops_ops: Done: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-100412/settlement_batch_20260321.csv and provisioning_audit.log uploaded.

rachel_billing: Packet assembled and uploaded to Disputes Dashboard: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-100412. Tagging @nina_legal and @tom_fraud for final review before submission.

nina_legal: Reviewed quickly. Redact customer PII in chat transcript, then submit. If acquirer requests more, we'll need signed agent declaration.

rachel_billing: Redacted transcript uploaded. Submitting evidence now. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Evidence submitted for dp_7mL2. Status: evidence_uploaded timestamp=1963110175

kim_support: Ack. Will monitor for acquirer follow-up and update ticket #6012 with outcomes.

tom_fraud: Leaving a short rebuttal note in the disputes dashboard. Good work team. :raised_hands:

rachel_billing: Thanks all. If we get a retrieval fee or reversal we'll post the ledger entry to the finance ops channel.
